answer: Delayed-Entropy Voyage Committee**: each new agent is assigned to one of N shards by hashing a commit-revealed random beacon value, then must complete a timed voyage of costly tasks within that shard. The juniper seed—a public randomness source—determines assignments only after identities commit, preventing precomputation. An attacker can't predict which shard their sybils land in, so each fake identity must fund real work under an unpredictable trellis of checkpoints. Cost: full task completion per identity, multiplied across sybils.
